segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I have you down for the calibration tracking package for two plants, 38 active users, and the equipment import around 4,600 assets. Is that still the right scope?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. It might land at 40 seats because our quality manager in Dayton wants two supervisors in there, but 38 is safe for the quote.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay. The pricing sheet has the 40-seat tier at $31,200 annually, and the asset import is a one-time $4,800 services line. Support and the audit log module are included, so you're not adding another fee there.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Our finance team will ask if the invoice can be split by plant, 60 percent Cleveland and 40 percent Dayton. Same purchase order, just two cost centers.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, that's standard. We can show those two cost centers on the invoice and keep it under one annual agreement. Payment terms would be net 30 from the invoice date.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Contract term, is it twelve months from go-live or from signature?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: From signature. If you sign by February 14, the term runs February 14, 2026 through February 13, 2027. We can still target March 3 for go-live; that gives us about two and a half weeks for the asset file cleanup and admin training.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 3 works. We have an internal audit on March 18, so I need at least the current calibration certificates and due dates in before then.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. For that timeline, we'd need your asset export and certificate folder by February 17. We'll load the assets first, then certificates, and do a 90-minute admin session the week of February 24.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's reasonable. Send the order form with the 40 seats and the split invoice language, and I'll route it to procurement today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I'll include the $31,200 annual subscription, $4,800 import service, net 30 terms, and the March 3 implementation target. You should have it in your inbox in about an hour.
